limitations: Six exact physical sources only. Salesforce and Nexus final, snake_case and CamelCase fields remain separate; no cross-CRM deduplication or joins.

Only unpadded nonempty strings up to 256 characters without whitespace or control characters are identifier syntax candidates. No numeric coercion, case folding, prefix inference or 15/18-character normalization is performed.

Private identifier hashes are namespace-and-object-qualified. Whole-record hashes and raw-line hashes preserve versions; every ID with multiple whole-record versions is quarantined from relationship checks. Multiple versions are not automatically business contradictions.

Forward document references and latest-published-version round trips are independent diagnostics. A latest reference is concordant only if the target version points back to the same document and both IDs have single full-record versions. Recorded is_latest flags do not elect a current version.

LinkedEntityId, ParentId, FirstPublishLocationId and ContentBodyId receive only type/presence and syntax counts; no target object type, account, person, ownership or commercial relationship is inferred.

No title, filename, path, URL, checksum, owner/person identifier or payload value is retained or separately hashed. Complete-record hashes detect unselected changes. No URL is dereferenced and no document is fetched.
Size fields are classified by strict nonnegative integer syntax and zero/positive category only. Units are unverified; no size value, byte total or unique leaked-content volume is reported.

Unknown enum text remains private source-and-field-qualified hashes. Flags preserve literal boolean and string categories without treating strings as verified booleans. All-row optional field absence is distinguished from first-row sampling.
Metadata, field presence and concordant literal references do not prove binary availability, sensitive content, access, executed contracts, current status, customers or incident impact.
Public field categories describe all selected rows. Nonempty includes whitespace strings and nonstring values unless their container is empty; it is not a count of usable files or valid URLs.
The extra-field count reports distinct top-level keys outside the declared field census. Unknown key names and enum hashes are omitted; their contents have not been reviewed.
Physical sources remain separate, including the verified-empty Salesforce link table. Raw Nexus counterparts remain outside this batch. No company association or incident deduplication is performed.
